test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A thief saw a policeman, and he started running at a speed of 18 m/s. After 12 seconds, the policeman starts running behind the thief at a certain speed. If the policeman covered 864 meters distance to reach the thief, then the speed (in m/s) of the policeman is:
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of thief (Sₜₕᵢₑf) = 18 m/s

Time taken by thief to start running before policeman starts = 12 seconds

Distance covered by policeman to catch the thief (Dₚₒₗᵢ꜀ₑₘₐₙ) = 864 meters

**Calculations:**

Distance covered by the thief in 12 seconds:

⇒ Dₜₕᵢₑf = Sₜₕᵢₑf × Time = 18 × 12 = 216 meters

Total distance between thief and policeman when policeman starts running = 216 m

Distance covered by thief while policeman was chasing = 864 - 216 = 648 m

The time taken by the thief to cover this distance = 648/18 = 36 seconds.

Which means the time taken by the policeman to reach the thief = 36 seconds

Speed of policeman = Total Distance /Total time

⇒ 864 / 36 = 24m/s

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
